diagram_candidates.claim: For weights beta,gamma, concatenation defines e(beta,gamma); the separated block algebra R(beta) tensor R(gamma) embeds into the corresponding corner of R(beta+gamma). Induction uses the left ideal R(beta+gamma)e(beta,gamma), while restriction sends L to e(beta,gamma)L.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The definition expressly identifies the embedding with horizontal concatenation of diagrams, and then defines both functors via the same idempotent corner. A diagram can make the algebra corner and the two functors easier to track.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Two adjacent blocks labelled beta and gamma concatenate to the beta+gamma block; show the map R(beta) tensor R(gamma) -> e(beta,gamma)R(beta+gamma)e(beta,gamma), r tensor s mapped to the commuting separated-block actions, marking that its image can be proper in the full corner. Beside it, show Ind(M boxtimes N)=R(beta+gamma)e(beta,gamma) tensor_{R(beta) tensor R(gamma)}(M tensor N), and Res(L)=e(beta,gamma)L. Check arrow directions, the corner idempotent, the left-ideal/right-module sides and the distinction between image and full corner against lines 37-39 and 43.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: All labels and maps are directly stated in the frozen source. No missing diagram error is confirmed; the definition is complete in prose and formulas.

diagram_candidates.claim: The PBW spanning proof moves dots to the right of crossings, with explicit correction terms for adjacent equal colours, and reduces crossing words using braid moves and quadratic relations.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The source gives two concrete local transformations and their correction terms; a small wire diagram can show why the normal form has reduced crossings followed by right-hanging dots.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw the two equal-colour dot-slide identities in line 50 with the correction idempotent term, then a braid move with its lower-crossing correction as described in line 52. Label strand colours and dot/crossing indices consistently with x_a, x_{a+1}, tau_a and e(nu); verify correction signs (+ for x_a tau_a, - for x_{a+1} tau_a) and that the target normal form places dots to the right. This would be explanatory only; the proof remains algebraic.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_status: The formulas and rewriting role are explicit in the source. No missing diagram error is confirmed; the algebraic explanation is already complete.
